slots.node03.text: Month-end close runs 12 days because reconciliations start after period end.
slots.node07.text: Rules check entries at posting and surface errors early.
slots.node08.text: Eleven entities match intercompany balances by email and spreadsheet.
slots.node12.text: Balances match daily, with exceptions routed to an owner.
slots.node13.text: Three sources report different revenue and nobody owns the difference.
slots.node17.text: Finance and operations read one set of numbers.
slots.node18.text: Controllers spend most of the cycle chasing status instead of analyzing.
slots.node22.text: Every entity, task and blocker is visible in one view.
slots.node23.text: We removed these constraints by redesigning the process before the platform.
slots.title: Each pain point has a design answer
